tariq.peopleops: Hey folks, urgent: employee had arthroscopic knee surgery on 04/08 and started rehab at 'PeakMotion PT'. Claim ID KNEE-2045 was denied OON citing provider mismatch. We have prior auth PA-11223 covering 8 sessions. Clinic says they billed under their parent org TIN but insurer expects the treating therapist's NPI. Need quick next steps + a proof-of-coverage note they can accept for upcoming appointments.

nina.benefits: Short answer: clinic must resubmit with correct rendering NPI and the billing TIN that matches insurer records. We'll also prepare a proof-of-coverage letter the member or clinic can use to keep appointments.

clinic-admin: For context, many clinics bill under the corporate TIN; schedulers often don't realize insurers map to individual NPIs. We can resubmit but need to know exact wording insurer prefers in the resubmission notes.

harper.hr: Can benefits draft the precise claim note they should add and a one-page proof PDF? Member flies out in 48 hrs, so time is tight.

nina.benefits: Suggested claim note: "Reprocessing request for claim KNEE-2045: please apply prior authorization PA-11223. Correct billing/provider credentials to rendering therapist NPI [enter NPI] and billing TIN [enter TIN] as per provider file. Denial attributed to provider credential mismatch. Attach itemized bill and PT plan of care." Ask them to set claim status to 'reconsideration' on resubmit.

benefits-bot: Generating proof-of-coverage (informational only)... Draft: "Redwood Inference \u2014 Proof of Coverage (not a guarantee of payment). Member: [NAME]. Plan: Redwood Core PPO. Coverage effective: 01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026. Prior authorization: PA-11223 (post-op knee rehab). For claims/resubmission questions call insurer 1-800-555-0199 or use insurer provider portal."

tariq.peopleops: Can we add a line to the PDF asking schedulers to confirm NPI/TIN used for billing matches insurer provider file? That usually speeds things.

nina.benefits: Done, include: "Please confirm billing provider NPI/TIN matches insurer provider file before resubmission." Also include our recommended script for clinics: "When resubmitting, reference PA-11223 in box 23 and mark as reconsideration/reprocessing."

clinic-admin: Great. We'll resubmit this morning and DM when done. If insurer rejects again, what's the escalation path?

nina.benefits: Escalate to insurer provider relations and file a reprocessing request showing PA-11223 and the EOB. If they decline, we move to medical appeals with PT notes and surgeon's postop order. Keep all itemized invoices and remittance advices.

harper.hr: Thanks—I'll send the proof PDF and the resubmission script to the employee. Please tag this thread when insurer escalation is opened.

tariq.peopleops: Appreciate it. Will follow up once clinic confirms resubmission. :white_check_mark:
